snippet.title: Little Crossroads - Official Alpha Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the Alpha Trailer for Little Crossroads, a life simulation sandbox game developed by Red Merle Games. Players will live in peace and harmony to meet friends, learn new skills, and experience life at their own pace. Little Crossroads is coming soon to PC (Steam).
